turns.text: Hi, can you give me the delivery address for order SC-3551? The order belongs to a relative.

I'm sorry, but I can't share any details about an order until I've verified it. To do that I need the order number and the email address the order was placed with. I also can't share details if the order was placed with someone else's email. If you have both, please send them and I'll check.
If you need an email, mine is jamie.holt@example.com. I only want the delivery address.

I couldn't verify that order with those details, so I can't share anything about it. Please check the order number and the email it was placed with. The email must be the one used for the order. If it belongs to your relative, they would need to give you that email or contact us themselves.

error.message: No order matches that order number and email. Ask the customer to check both.
